content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Atlanta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria now to confirm your qualifications before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's training program.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend all sessions from your home or office, interact with active certified practitioners in real time, and build the foundation you need to pass the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the training, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application, including your education and experience details. Pay the required exam fee directly to PMI to activate your eligibility to sit for the test.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam when ready, and complete the computer-based assessment at an authorized testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Pursue training, attend conferences, or contribute to your profession—Granite PM Academy and PMI offer multiple pathways to fulfill renewal requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.

fq_items.question: Is PMP certification worth pursuing for Atlanta project managers?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Atlanta's largest employers—including logistics giants like UPS and The Home Depot, healthcare systems like Emory and Wellstar, and tech-forward companies like Delta and AT&T—actively seek PMP-certified professionals. The credential strengthens your negotiating position on salary and opens doors across the region's strongest sectors: logistics, IT, healthcare, and construction. Demand for credentialed project managers remains robust, making certification a practical investment in your career trajectory.

fq_items.question: Which Atlanta industries value PMP certification most highly?
fq_items.answer: PMP certification carries particular weight in Atlanta's logistics and supply-chain sector, IT departments, and healthcare operations—three areas where major employers post the credential as preferred or required. Film and entertainment (including production studios), construction and real estate development, and fintech firms also recognize the value of certified practitioners. Your certification signals readiness to manage complex, regulated, or high-stakes initiatives across these competitive markets.

You'll participate in real-time sessions and interact with instructors without commuting to a physical classroom.

fq_items.question: Should Atlanta project managers pursue PMP or CAPM first?
fq_items.answer: If you meet PMI's experience requirements, pursue PMP directly—the credential will accelerate your earning potential and career advancement in Atlanta's competitive job market. If you're early in your career or lack formal project management experience, CAPM is a respected entry point recognized by local employers and builds a foundation for PMP certification later. Both credentials enhance your profile; choose based on your current experience level and career timeline.
